Thanks for the constraints. I sketched a short MAP and a weekly sprint grid that aligns with your windows. I'm attaching a compact spreadsheet (cs_map_v1.xlsx) and a one-page risk register. Highlights below:

Proposed high-level milestones (owner — target date):
- Procurement & contract sign: Ben Carter — Dec 10
- Data ingestion sandbox & access: FathomAI + Brightwave — Dec 22 (data window preserved)
- Compliance evidence collection (SOC2 scopes): Naomi Feldman — Jan 8
- Pilot ingestion + load test: Redwood infra team (Ben) + FathomAI — Feb 4
- Pilot review & go/no-go: Chloe Martin / Liam — Feb 11

Weekly sprint rhythm (sample):
- Week 1 (Dec 13): Contract close, kickoff, and procure reserved capacity
- Week 2 (Dec 20): Data transfer (sandbox), mapping, and KV cache alignment
- Week 3 (Dec 27): Integration tests, quantization checks, and early load tests
- Week 4 (Jan 3): Compliance packaging and evidence review
- Week 6 (Feb 1): Scale load testing and performance tuning

Open items for you:
1) Confirm procurement approver and sign date (we'll move capacity reservations accordingly).
2) Share the exact data sample format so our infra team can prepare ingestion transforms.
3) Any blackout dates in Jan for your team?

I've kept owners intentionally narrow to limit handoffs. Ben — can you confirm SLA for burst capacity on the Dec 20-31 window? Naomi — can you confirm compliance evidence lead time expectations?

I'll update the spreadsheet and post a shared sheet link after we get confirmations. If it looks good, let's lock a 30-min kickoff on Dec 14 to finalize owners.

Best,
Chloe
